data.title: Sick pay (Krankengeld) partly rejected
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sick pay (Krankengeld) is suspended from 12 January 2026 because the incapacity certificate was reported late. It will only pay from 22 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your sick pay entitlement is suspended (ruht) because your incapacity for work was not reported within one week. The certificate arrived on 22 January 2026, so payment only starts then. You may disagree and file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at Muster BKK; the app shows the deadline. If you think the certificate was reported in time, or you had a good reason for the delay, consider getting advice, for example from a social advisory service. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final.

items.title: File objection against sick pay decision
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person for the record at Muster BKK.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if no objection is filed in time.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
